notes.file: Copy, edit, point `bot --config` at it. Every number here costs money, so none of them defaults: a fee rate that quietly defaults is a fee rate nobody checked.
notes.fees: Hyperliquid perp taker, measured on two venues rather than assumed - see config/default.toml and docs/phase-1-findings.md.
notes.schedule: lag_hours is the gap between the signal and the first fill: phase 1 measured Sharpe 2.22 at one hour against 0.29 at twenty-four. slices spreads the orders over that many hours; impact falls as 1/sqrt(N) while the signal decays, so the window widens with the account - two at $30k, four at $300k, eight at $3M.
notes.markets: An asset absent from `markets` cannot be traded at all. That is the safe direction: an unknown lot size becomes a rejected order rather than a guessed one.
notes.marks: Prices are read from state_dir/marks.json, written by whatever holds the price feed. This process does not fetch them - a bot with its own feed is a bot with its own opinion about value.
